title: Find large approved loans
summary: SELECT, JOIN, WHERE with two conditions, ORDER BY with a tie-breaker.

tests.name: right rows, right columns, right order

hints: Join the tables on the column they share: `FROM loans l JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id`.
Two loans have exactly 5,00,000. Without a second ORDER BY key their order is not defined, and PostgreSQL may return either one first. Add `l.loan_id` as the tie-breaker.
